nodes.name: Oxidation of pristine DND
nodes.procedure: Pristine DND powder (1 g) was added to a 100 ml mixture of H₂SO₄ and HNO₃ (3:1 volume ratio) and refluxed at 160°C for 24 h. When cooled down, the oxidized DND was washed with deionized water several times until a pH value of 7 was achieved, followed by lyophilization to dry it.

nodes.source_text: Pristine DND powder (1 g) was added to a 100 ml mixture of H₂SO₄ and HNO₃ (3:1 volume ratio) and refluxed at 160°C for 24 h (ref. 37).

nodes.name: Thermal deoxygenation of oxidized DND to OLC
nodes.procedure: The oxidized DND powder obtained from step 1 was treated by thermal deoxygenation at 1,500°C under an Ar atmosphere to obtain OLC supports.
nodes.source_text: the obtained powder was treated by thermal deoxygenation at different temperatures under an Ar atmosphere... DND was automatically transformed into an OLC at elevated temperatures (>900°C)

nodes.name: Pt ALD deposition on OLC
nodes.procedure: Deposition of Pt atoms onto the OLC 1,500°C support was carried out on a viscous flow reactor (GEMSTAR-6TM Benchtop ALD, Arradiance) at 150°C using the MeCpPtMe3 precursor (99.9%, Sigma Aldrich) and O3. Ultrahigh purity N2 (99.999%) was used as the carrier gas at a flow rate of 200 ml min⁻¹. The precursor container was heated to 65°C. The chamber was heated to 150°C and the manifold was held at 110°C. The timing sequence was 40, 120, 120 and 120 s for MeCpPtMe3 exposure, N2 purge, O3 exposure and N2 purge, respectively.
nodes.source_text: Deposition of Pt atoms onto the OLC 1,500°C support was carried out... The timing sequence was 40, 120, 120 and 120 s...

nodes.name: Graphene oxide synthesis (improved Hummers)
nodes.procedure: A mixture of 120 ml of concentrated H₂SO₄ and 14 ml of H₃PO₄ was added to graphite flakes (1.0 g), then the temperature was held at around 35-40°C and 6 g of KMnO₄ was slowly added to it. The reaction was carried out at 50°C and stirred for 12 h. When cooled down, ice along with several drops of 30 wt% H₂O₂ were poured in until the solution turned yellow. The precipitates were filtered out and washed using 300 ml of 5 wt% HCl three times, followed by deionized water several times until a pH value of 7 was attained. The final products were freeze-dried.
nodes.source_text: Graphene oxide was prepared by the improved method according to the previous report38. In brief, a mixture of 120 ml of concentrated H₂SO₄ and 14 ml of H₃PO₄ was added to graphite flakes (1.0 g)...

nodes.name: Graphene annealing
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared graphene oxide nanosheets were annealed at 1,050°C for 10 min under an Ar atmosphere.
nodes.source_text: The as-prepared graphene oxide nanosheets were annealed at 1,050°C for 10 min under an Ar atmosphere...

nodes.name: Pt ALD on graphene
nodes.procedure: One-cycle ALD procedure using the same timing sequence as that for Pt1/OLC: 40, 120, 120 and 120 s for MeCpPtMe3 exposure, N2 purge, O3 exposure and N2 purge, respectively, at 150°C.
nodes.source_text: We carried out a one-cycle ALD procedure using the same timing sequence as that for Pt1/OLC.
